mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doc_generation (id, template_code, title, content, file_path, create_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{templateCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{filePath}, #{createTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE doc_generation SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM doc_generation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM doc_generation WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
